logger.message: #["[START] flow=" ++ flow.name ++ " | correlationId=" ++ correlationId ++ " | topic=" ++ attributes.topic ++ " | partition=" ++ attributes.partition as String ++ " | offset=" ++ attributes.offset as String ++ " | env=" ++ p("mule.env")]
logger.doc:name: Log Kafka Message Received

os:retrieve.key: #["{{CONSUMER_PREFIX}}-" ++ attributes.topic ++ "-" ++ attributes.partition as String ++ "-" ++ attributes.offset as String]
os:retrieve.doc:name: Check Idempotency Key

logger.message: #["[DUPLICATE] flow=" ++ flow.name ++ " | correlationId=" ++ correlationId ++ " | offset=" ++ attributes.offset as String ++ " | skipping"]
logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate

os:store.key: #["{{CONSUMER_PREFIX}}-" ++ attributes.topic ++ "-" ++ attributes.partition as String ++ "-" ++ attributes.offset as String]
os:store.doc:name: Mark as Processed

logger.message: #["[END] flow=" ++ flow.name ++ " | correlationId=" ++ correlationId ++ " | offset=" ++ vars.kafkaOffset as String]
logger.doc:name: Log Processing End
